independent_static_review.scope: All three final source/test pins, including the follow-up late-quote-expiry rollback test; no tests or Host run by reviewer.

semantics: V2 represents only a newly generated successful managed-paper fill; its time is MANAGED_PAPER_MATCH Unix-epoch nanoseconds, not venue execution time.
One match-time sample drives evaluation and receipt replay; the later local event-created time remains diagnostic only.
Exact receipt binds event/cursor/generation, intent/scope/account/strategy, quote source/cursor, incremental economics, fee currency/model, and receipt digest.
The reader validates the durable chain in one read-only SQLite snapshot. V1 rows remain readable but return no V2 fill and are never promoted.
Quote expiry between evaluation and event commit rolls back order/event/receipt/book writes. The separate one-attempt dispatch claim is latched UNKNOWN; duplicate intent does not rematch.
